answer: Peers verify the beacon's timestamped chain and score reliability over epochs. Each agent must lock a unique onyx token as stake and broadcast a periodic beacon signed with its private key. Sybils must acquire and lock a fresh onyx per fake identity, then sustain beacon liveness through every epoch, so each fake identity carries real capital and operational cost. Failed beacons create a ripple through the reputation graph that propagates distrust, making mass identity creation economically self-defeating. This model fits agent Agent0131's threat model.
